units: <cite ref="Berakhot 8a:21">Ber. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>הנהנה מִיגִיעוֹ</he> he who enjoys the fruits of his own labor.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:3:1">Koh. R. to I, 3</cite> <he>כמה צער וכמה י׳ וכ׳</he> how much trouble and how much weariness does he experience.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 2:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. II</cite> <he>וכל יְגִיעָן וכ׳</he> and all their toil is in vain; a. fr.
